title: Phase 9: Fork Maintenance Strategy
description:
Establish surgical fork strategy to stay close to Fizzy upstream

Tasks:
- git diff fizzy/main vs beads integration branch
- Identify minimal changeset for beads support
- Document which files/features we modify
- Create merge strategy for upstream updates
- Ensure we can pull Fizzy improvements easily

Goal: Maintainable fork that tracks upstream

title: Phase 6: Real-Time Bridge
description:
Poll beads mutations and broadcast to Fizzy clients via Turbo Streams

Tasks:
- Create BeadsBridge service to poll mutations
- Background polling job (every 500ms)
- Broadcast Turbo Stream updates when issues change
- Start polling when board viewed

Goal: See agent changes in real-time without refresh
